memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Polycystic ovary syndrome.
Patient reports irregular menses, mild hirsutism, and weight gain. BMI 28 kg/m2, blood pressure 118/72, pulse 78. Abdomen soft, no palpable masses. Smoking status: never. Spirometry: FEV1 2.85 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.30 L, FEV1/FVC 0.86; change from baseline +0.02 L. Inhaler technique: not applicable. Asthma Control Test not applicable (no asthma). Assessment: PCOS likely, metabolic profile normal. Plan: start metformin 500 mg BD and combined oral contraceptive pill OD; order baseline labs; review in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Metformin 500 mg tablets, take one tablet twice daily.
Combined oral contraceptive pill (ethinylestradiol 30 µg + levonorgestrel 150 µg), take one tablet daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum testosterone: 48 ng/dL (reference 15‑70).
LH:FSH ratio: 1.9 (reference <2).
HbA1c: 5.5% (reference 4.0‑5.6).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been noticing my periods are coming every 45‑60 days and I have some unwanted hair on my chin. I’ve also gained about 4 kg over the past year despite my usual diet. I’m worried about my fertility and would like to start treatment soon.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Polycystic ovary syndrome.
Patient reports more regular menses (approx every 32 days) and reduced facial hair. Weight stable at 68 kg. BP 120/74, pulse 80. No acne flare. Smoking status: never. Spirometry: FEV1 2.88 L (93% predicted), FVC 3.32 L, FEV1/FVC 0.87; change +0.03 L since last visit. Inhaler technique: not applicable. Asthma Control Test: not applicable. Assessment: good response to metformin and OCP; metabolic parameters improved. Plan: continue current meds; repeat labs in 3 months; lifestyle advice reinforced.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-01-15 at 10:00 with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Polycystic ovary syndrome.
Patient reports breakthrough spotting mid‑cycle and mild nausea since starting OCP. Weight unchanged. BP 119/72, pulse 78. Smoking status: never. Spirometry: FEV1 2.90 L (94% predicted), FVC 3.35 L, FEV1/FVC 0.87; change +0.02 L since last visit. Inhaler technique: not applicable. Asthma Control Test: not applicable. Assessment: likely OCP‑related side effects. Plan: switch to low‑dose OCP (ethinylestradiol 20 µg + levonorgestrel 100 µg) OD; continue metformin; repeat labs in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Polycystic ovary syndrome.
Patient reports no spotting, regular cycles every 28‑30 days, and mild improvement in hirsutism. Weight 67 kg. BP 120/70, pulse 76. Smoking status: never. Spirometry: FEV1 2.92 L (95% predicted), FVC 3.38 L, FEV1/FVC 0.86; change +0.02 L since last visit. Inhaler technique: not applicable. Asthma Control Test: not applicable. Assessment: stable on current regimen; ovarian volume unchanged on prior ultrasound. Plan: continue metformin and low‑dose OCP; schedule pelvic ultrasound to assess ovarian morphology.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Pelvic ultrasound: Bilateral ovaries show multiple small follicles (2‑9 mm); volume 6.8 mL each (reference <10 mL). No dominant cyst. Endometrial thickness 5.5 mm (proliferative pattern).
